text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

CORN SALE - Taiwan's FGEP group bought 54,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn Wednesday from Zennoh for September 1-15 shipment if from the U.S. Gulf or September 16-30 from the Pacific Northwest (PNW), traders said.
- Morocco bought 46,000 tonnes of U.S. No.2 corn Tuesday with 20,500 for August 10-20 arrival and 25,500 for September 10-20 arrival.

WHEAT SALE - The CCC bought 60,000 tonnes of US HRW wheat for donation to Kyrgyzstan. Shipment was for July 16-31. It bought the wheat from Continental Grain, with 54,000 tonnes at $135.87 and the balance at $137.27.
WHEAT TENDER - The CCC on July 9 will tender to buy 35,000 tonnes of hard red winter for donation to Tajikistan. Shipment was scheduled for July 23 to August 7.
CORN TENDER - International Commodity Dealers of London won a tender to supply Kenya with 80,000 tonnes of corn, the state National Cereals and Produce Board said.

CORN TENDERS - Taiwan's Members Feed Industry Group was to tender late Wednesday for 54,000 tonnes of No. 2 U.S. corn, U.S. exporters said. It seeks the corn for August 6-20 shipment from U.S. Gulf or August 21 to September 5 from the Pacific Northwest.

SOYMEAL TENDER - The Commodity Credit Corp reduced the soymeal tonnage it seeks for Guatemala to 1,389 tonnes from 4,560 tonnes, the CCC said. All other details were unchanged. The tender was set for Wednesday with shipment for July 17-31.

RICE TENDER - Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foodstuffs (GEZA) on Monday issued an international tender to buy 24,000 tonnes of white rice for August delivery, a GEZA spokesman said. He told Reuters that July 23 was set as the final date to submit offers and that results would be made available on July 24.

MARKET TALK - The European Union agreed the supply of 15,480 onnes of maize food aid for North Korea at 127.84 ecus a tonne FOB, the EU Official Journal said. The maize was due to be delivered to the port of shipment between July 14-27.

--USDA said Pakistan will buy 30,000 tonnes of U.S. soymeal in fiscal 1997 (October-September) under a newly signed PL480 sales agreement. USDA will issue purchase authorizations for Pakistan to complete the transaction at a later date. Delivery of commodities purchased under the program must occur by Dec 31.

MARKET TALK - USDA said Wednesday it is donating 11,525 tonnes of rice, wheat flour, vegetable oil and other foodstuffs to five former Soviet republics. The largest donation is to Kyrgyzstan, which will receive 3,000 tonnnes of rice, vegetable oil and wheat flour for distribution to infants and children under treatment for blood diseases. The other donations include 2,500 tonnes of rice, vegetable oil and bulgur wheat to Armenia also for distribution to children suffering from blood diseases; 2,225 of rice, beans, vegetable oils and wheat flour to vunerable groups in Georgia; 2,000 of rice, dry whole milk and wheat flour for hospitals, orphanages, kindergartens and other institutions in Moldova; and 1,800 of rice, dry whole milk, wheat flour, and vegetable oil to hospitals, orphanages, kindergartens and other institutions in Ukraine.
